svg.title: SFE5 Inferred Biome Fills
svg.desc: Biome fills inferred from beta-only numbered Regions as separator strokes. Cliff height 0 is rendered as water/out of bounds. Cliff walls act as biome boundaries, but ramp footprints bridge cliff-height changes so a biome can travel up or down ramps.
